purpose: Separate probability models p_n(T)=P(Y_n(T)=1 | X_{T-60s}) for same-direction series of n consecutive BTC 5m Polymarket outcomes starting at T. Prediction quality versus benchmarks only; no policy, quoting, execution, stakes or PnL.
n_values_source: User choice 2026-11-22 from the development support table (n=2..7).

label.definition: Y_n(T)=1 iff the n outcomes of markets starting T, T+5m, ..., T+5(n-1)m are all UP or all DOWN; outcome n+1 is outside the label.
label.calendar: One aligned UTC five-minute grid; a missing, unresolved, cancelled or ambiguous (duplicate) slot makes every window containing it non-qualifying; no bridging to the next existing row.
label.label_available_at: max over the n component availability times; NaT if any is unknown; identical rule for both classes

official_gamma.outcome_verification: target_polymarket_up must agree with one-hot outcome_prices_current over outcomes (up, down) and market_closed_current must be true; otherwise the slot is missing.
official_gamma.availability_rule: max(resolved_at_utc, market_start_utc + 5 minutes) + 60 seconds (E0031/E0039 release rule); resolved_at_utc is a current-metadata field, not an archived observation time. Missing resolved_at_utc -> availability unknown, label kept for counts, never fit/calibration eligible.
official_gamma.read_filter: pyarrow filter market_start_utc < cutoff at read time

binance_index_proxy.role: separate longer-history experiment; never evidence about official outcomes
binance_index_proxy.contract: features/btc_preopen_contract.py (btc_preopen_v1): Close[T+4m] >= Open[T], all five 1m candles, ties UP, available T+5m
binance_index_proxy.read_filter: stream lines and stop at the first Opened >= cutoff; only its timestamp prefix is inspected

boundaries.window_rule: all n component market starts must be < cutoff
boundaries.purge: A training example is eligible for a stage with boundary B only if label_available_at <= B; for an outer fold B = fold start - 60s (first decision). Feature warm-up history is not purged.

features_plan.generator_revision: perf/polars-numba @ cb89449 (to be re-pinned before generator fitting)
features_plan.base: BASE25 per TrilevelOptTrader docs/base_features_v2_contract.md, rebuilt on Hyperliquid 1m with documented field availability
features_plan.status: NOT_STARTED; requires field-availability audit and representative cost measurement first

benchmarks: empirical prior-history rate per fold/source/n counted over forecast slots

environment.reason: Earlier pyenv 3.14.4 environment is absent; user approved this venv on 2026-11-22.

prohibitions: No holdout rows read or materialized; no generator fit, model fit, tuning or calibration in the inventory stage; holdout evaluation only in a separate run after the procedure is frozen.
